name: Weekly Email Scan Sep Khanh - 21h30 T7

payload.message:
QUET EMAIL TUAN CUA SEP KHANH — 21H T7 HANG TUAN.

MUC DICH: Tom tat tat ca email QUAN TRONG ma Sep nhan duoc trong tuan (T2-T7), de Sep nhin lai ca tuan, biet con email nao chua xu ly.

QUY TAC:
1. CHI quet email gui TRUC TIEP cho dhk@nsca.vn (to: dhk@nsca.vn). KHONG quan tam CC.
2. Filter 7 ngay (168h): `exec: node /app/google-tools/gmail-read.js 168 100 "to:dhk@nsca.vn -cc:dhk@nsca.vn"`
3. Phan loai 4 nhom:
   - 🔴 KHAN/CHUA tra loi: Email co tu 'urgent', 'gap', deadline, hoac chua co response
   - 📋 NOI BO: Tu @nsca.vn (BP, NPP)
   - 🌐 NGOAI: Khach hang, doi tac, OEM
   - 💼 DOI TAC QUOC TE: Tu nuoc ngoai (santiago@, OEM nuoc ngoai)
4. Giao Gemini tom tat (FREE):
   `node /app/google-tools/gemini-write.js "Tom tat email tuan cho CEO theo 4 nhom (urgent/noi bo/ngoai/quoc te). Moi email 1 dong: [nguoi gui] - [tom tat 1 cau]. Ket thuc: liet ke email QUAN TRONG chua co tra loi." 4000`
5. Tao Google Doc:
   `exec: node /app/google-tools/gdoc-create.js "Tom tat email tuan [XX] - [DD/MM]" "<content Gemini>"`
6. Gui email Sep + 1 tin Zalo:
   - Email: `exec: node /app/google-tools/gmail-send.js "dhk@nsca.vn" "[Le Na] Tom tat email tuan [XX]" "<HTML voi tom tat + link Doc + chu ky Le Na>" ""`
   - Zalo: `exec: node /app/google-tools/zalo-oa-send.js sep-khanh "📧 EMAIL TUAN [XX]\n🔴 Khan/chua tra loi: N\n📋 Noi bo: M | 🌐 Ngoai: K | 💼 Quoc te: L\n📄 Chi tiet: <link Doc>"`

KHONG phan tich chien luoc, KHONG de xuat. Chi tom tat thong ke.

QUET BAO CAO TUAN + LUU NOI DUNG — 21H THU 7 HANG TUAN.

MUC DICH: Khong chi dem ai nop/chua nop. PHAI LUU NOI DUNG tom tat de cuoi thang dung lam BC thang.

LUU Y: CHI 11 BP can nop bao cao tuan TRUC TIEP. BO (tamntt@), BD Noi dia (ducdd@), BD Intl (santiago@) bao cao cho PKD (ndao@) → KHONG nhac 3 BP nay.

BUOC 1: Quet email bao cao tu 11 BP trong 7 ngay qua:
`exec: node /app/google-tools/gmail-read.js 168 50 "from:nsca.vn subject:(bao cao OR report OR weekly OR tuan)"`

BUOC 2: Doi chieu voi 11 BP can nop:
- R&D (namph@), HCNS (sondt@), PKD (ndao@), TCKT (duannt@), SX Nhom (ngocnv@), SX Thep (tunghm@), Co Dien (phongdv@), QAQC (tuannl@), Kho (hant@), Giao Hang (ducvt@), Cung Ung (anhdtk@)

BUOC 3: VOI MOI BC NHAN DUOC → giao Gemini tom tat 4-5 dong (FREE):
`node /app/google-tools/gemini-write.js "Tom tat ngan gon BC tuan cua [BP]: 1) Cong viec da lam, 2) Ket qua chinh (con so), 3) Van de gap phai, 4) Ke hoach tuan toi. Moi muc 1 dong, tong khong qua 5 dong." 1500`

BUOC 4: GHI VAO SHEET 'Report Tracker':
`exec: node /app/google-tools/sheets-append.js "$GOOGLE_SHEET_ID" "'Report Tracker'!A:F" '[["<tuan XX>", "<BP>", "<ngay nop>", "<email subject>", "<tom tat Gemini>", "<email_message_id>"]]'`
→ Mot row cho moi BC nhan duoc. Du data de cuoi thang dung tong hop.

BUOC 5: GHI VAO SHEET 'Weekly Performance' (1 row tom tat tuan):
`exec: node /app/google-tools/sheets-append.js "$GOOGLE_SHEET_ID" "'Weekly Performance'!A:E" '[["<tuan XX>", "<ngay T7>", "<so BP da nop>", "<so BP chua nop>", "<diem nhan tuan>"]]'`

BUOC 6: 1 TIN ZALO cho Sep Khanh:
   📊 BAO CAO TUAN [XX]
   Da nop: N/11 BP, da luu noi dung vao Sheet
   Chua nop: [ten cac BP] (se nhac luc 21h CN)

LUU Y QUAN TRONG: PHAI luu noi dung BC vao Sheet (BUOC 4-5), KHONG chi dem so luong. Cuoi thang Le Na can data nay de viet BC thang voi so lieu thuc.

NHAC NHO BC TUAN — 21H CN.

LUU Y: CHI nhac trong 11 BP. KHONG nhac BO/BD Noi dia/BD Intl (ho bao cao cho PKD).

BUOC 1: Doc sheet 'Report Tracker' xem BP nao trong 11 BP CHUA NOP tuan nay.
`exec: node /app/google-tools/sheets-read.js "$GOOGLE_SHEET_ID" "'Report Tracker'!A:F"`
11 BP: R&D (namph@), HCNS (sondt@), PKD (ndao@), TCKT (duannt@), SX Nhom (ngocnv@), SX Thep (tunghm@), Co Dien (phongdv@), QAQC (tuannl@), Kho (hant@), Giao Hang (ducvt@), Cung Ung (anhdtk@).

BUOC 2: XAC MINH QUA EMAIL — voi MOI BP "chua nop" theo sheet, kiem tra email THUC TE:
`exec: node /app/google-tools/gmail-read.js 168 5 "from:<email_BP>"`
Doc KY ket qua. Neu BP da gui email co tinh chat bao cao (subject hoac body co: bao cao, report, tuan, weekly, cap nhat, tong hop, tinh hinh, ket qua) → COI LA DA NOP, KHONG nhac BP do.
CHI nhac nhung BP KHONG co email nao giong bao cao trong 7 ngay.

BUOC 3: Neu con BP THUC SU chua nop (sau khi xac minh email):
- Gui 1 EMAIL DUY NHAT (KHONG phai nhieu email):
  - To: danh sach email BP chua nop (gop CSV trong tham so to)
  - Cc: dhk@nsca.vn
  - Subject: '[NHAC] Nop bao cao tuan [XX] truoc 8h T2'
  - Body: Danh sach BP chua nop + deadline 8h T2
- Lenh: `node /app/google-tools/gmail-send.js "email1,email2,email3" "[NHAC] Nop bao cao tuan XX" "<body HTML co chu ky Le Na>" "dhk@nsca.vn"`

BUOC 4: 1 tin Zalo bao cao Sep (1 TIN DUY NHAT, KHONG gui nhieu tin):
`exec: node /app/google-tools/zalo-oa-send.js sep-khanh "📋 NHAC BC: N BP chua nop. Da gui email."`

Neu TAT CA 11 BP da nop → gui Zalo: '✅ 11/11 BP da nop BC tuan. Khong can nhac.'

QUAN TRONG: TONG CONG chi gui TOI DA 1 email + 1 tin Zalo. KHONG gui nhieu hon.
